title: store-request: the store world's sessions must not expire against the real clock (F1)
prior_work: Found work F1 (screens-action job, 4 Nov), with priority: it keeps screens-action (72 tests) and interface-shell red at tranche. The store world in bio-plane/test/m/store-request/door.mjs signs members in on its fixed clock (1 Oct 2026), and session.e (line 650) is the login's expiry on that clock. interface-shell's readRecord compares e with the real Date.now(), so since about 31 Oct every store-world page opens signed out. Make the world's session not run out against the real clock: a record expiry far in the real future, or none, without changing interface-shell or the plane's own expiry rule. Add a test that a world member's session reads as signed in whatever today's date is, failing with the change reverted. Then check screens-action's suite passes with your change (node --import ./test/platform-sqlite.mjs --test test/m/screens-action/ in bio-plane), but do not edit it, and report its count. Only F1 is this job's; leave the file's other unmet marks. If this module's own suite has red tests at the start commit from other modules (for example ai-accounts' removed names, now restored by job ai-accounts PR 124), name them in --not-verified, and block only if they stop job complete. Edit no other module, and commit no generated file (rows.mjs, words-unreviewed.json, any dist). Where build/situations/job.md names the old tool (proc), follow this START's commands instead.
